title: FREELAB v0.10.19 — Unified AI controls & reliable 3D
changes: Desktop/mobile and gallery now use one in-page confirmation/entry overlay; no browser-native confirm, prompt or alert dialogs for AI and account actions.

Capture actions reuse three roundels (microphone, describe, extract) over selected photo, with extra tools including 3D under a contextual three-dot menu; a second shutter row is hidden while inspecting.

Multiline, expandable instruction composer supports image edits, questions, extraction, targeted segment refinement and image-guided 3D prompt submissions. The microphone uses an actual microphone icon.
Live AI requests show an animated active border and progress chip, keeping results below the photo rather than disappearing in notifications.
Read-only saved-description history is restored to capture and gallery views without new paid inference calls.
3D connection check distinguishes configured provider key from a successful generation and shows recent job states without charging credits. Paid submissions require explicit confirmation.
AHOLO Lux3D receives encoded JPEG pixels directly instead of a temporary private image URL; creative prompts select its text-to-3D route with an optional reference image, not silently ignored.

3D status checks display real provider state and error text, with polling only while the capture view is open. Completed GLBs are downloaded into a 12 MB bounded private server cache when the provider download host is allowlisted; owners can retrieve saved assets after link expiry.
Audio recording uses AudioWorkletNode when available, with legacy ScriptProcessor fallback only for older browsers.
XR capture roundels moved slightly lower to reduce panel overlap. Live AHOLO billing, task success and Quest positioning require production/device verification.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.18 — Quest renderer and compact capture experience
changes: Quest immersive AR now prefers WebGL2, uses an XRWebGLLayer without unsupported DOM overlay, reduces compositor framebuffer scale and stops GPU work after context loss. Landing Three.js renderer is disabled in Quest Browser to prevent competing contexts.
Mobile browsers without immersive-ar support show ENTER 3D; launch an interactive private Three.js spatial preview of existing sources and branches (not a claim of AR passthrough).
Development log uses shorter copy, compact scroll window, round borderless close button and smaller release typography.
Top navigation pills use consistent desktop heights and spacing and reduce on narrow screens.
Camera studio distinguishes live video from an inspected image. Selected source or segment shows overlaid Voice, Describe and Extract controls; library is toggled, not required to use AI.
More menu contains full advanced camera, extraction quality, named segmentation, manual save and optional sampling controls without a separate legacy-controls section.
Image instruction composer supports prompt edits, descriptions, extraction, refined segmentation, 3D generation and voice. Provider calls remain explicit and billable work requires confirmation.
Collection uses image-first thumbnails, name/date overlays, a 3-dot per-object contextual menu and live filtering by label, date, description and metadata.
Full-screen gallery fills the available viewport, has compact white circular side arrows, mobile swipe navigation and a contextual menu for image AI actions.
Live Quest rendering and all webcam/AI combinations still require device verification; fallback never fabricates readable passthrough camera pixels.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.17 — XR controls, collaboration and profile management
changes: Development log now shows current release and scrollable previous release history.
Settings profile photo uses a clickable circular upload control, with upload or camera choice supported by the device.
Administrators can list users, reset passwords, temporarily block/unblock accounts, and remove non-admin users; sensitive changes revoke sessions.
XR image labels render only once in the viewer-sized caption (white); card action labels turn pink on hover.
Theater navigation buttons form a near-eye bottom row with white background and dark symbols.
Lower and shrink voice transcript and confirmation controls; move capture roundels away from game actions; reposition description panel and billboard config panel.
Mascot speech is stopped when hidden; contextual comments have larger variety, per-phrase repetition cooldown and audio overlap protection.
Voice search highlights and temporarily brings forward matching saved segments. Global restyle commands ask for second confirmation and cap edits to six billed images.
New optional XR depth entry requests depth-sensing before session begins, checks enabledFeatures correctly and reports sensor availability without claiming occlusion.
Joined spectators appear as named room-presence badges in host XR, and optional experimental frame outlines are shared to desktop room viewers (off by default).
Provider API test remains separate from asynchronous AHOLO Lux3D creation, polling and result retrieval.
WebRTC audio/video, physical passthrough rectangle screenshots and texture bin require additional permissions, signaling and calibration; not claimed as available in this release.

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.16 — Active nginx virtual host repair
changes: Fix ES module MIME on the nginx vhost that is actually loaded, even if sites-available differs from sites-enabled
Add active-vhost discovery and safe refusal for multiple or unrelated virtual hosts
Back up and roll back both nginx config files when live and canonical locations differ
Make room-viewer.mjs and scene.mjs explicit application/javascript locations and verify via real HTTPS before completing
Retain the v0.10.15 desktop rooms, mobile capture studio, XR accessibility and brand updates

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.15 — Server-layout deployment fix
changes: Correct deployment test to work without the repository-root watcher in Ubuntu release directories
Preserve v0.10.14 desktop room, mobile capture, XR typography and branding improvements
Keep nginx JavaScript MIME verification and rollback protection for ES modules

history.title: FREELAB v0.10.14 — Spatial rooms & capture studio
changes: Fix nginx MIME for all ES modules; pre-deploy check catches broken room viewer
Spatial room captions use fixed CSS text size with clickable branches and live FPS display
Mobile capture studio: source photography, image tree, voice, refine, describe, edit and 3D actions
XR menus: white text by default, pastel pink on hover; borderless theatrical fullscreen
Pastel animated brand, private profile picture, subtle mascot particles, updated footer

history.title: Three.js Spatial Rooms · v0.10.13
changes: Replaced the canvas-based room mockup with a fullscreen, continuously rendered Three.js spatial viewer
Added fluid orbit/zoom with pointer inertia, Fit Scene, and free-flight exploration with WASD, Q/E and Shift
Spectators see a tracked headset avatar with live head orientation, actual 3D image planes and parent-child branch links
Click a floating image to inspect the full media, saved description, ancestor or child links, and enlarge it
The room feed now includes authenticated metadata and headset/card orientations; camera pixels are never streamed
XR room publishing and desktop state polling run multiple times per second; Three.js rendering is independent of polling
Room UI and gallery fill the viewport and do not alter the private-by-default invitation model or archive data
